snippet.title: Sol Cresta [Switch/PS4/PC] BitSummit THE 8th BIT Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Bridging the gap of 36 years since the release of Terra Cresta in 1985, Sol Cresta is the next entry in the free-form docking and shooting game series.

More details here: https://worthplaying.com/game/15593-sol-cresta/

Sol Cresta is coming to Nintendo Switch, PS4 and PC on December 9, 2021.
